title: Google Garf Declarative SQL Reporting & Multi-Destination Data Pipeline Architecture
summary: Architectural distillation of Google Garf (v0.2.0-core, 588 commits, commit dad42091), an enterprise framework unifying reporting APIs (Google Ads, Analytics, YouTube, REST) behind declarative SQL queries. Details query compilation, dynamic date macro resolution (:YYYYMMDD-N), in-memory GarfReport matrices, heterogeneous analytical writers (BigQuery, DuckDB, SQLite), deterministic zero-network simulation, and two-stage DAG workflow execution.

references.description: QueryEditor, macro replacements, and virtual column expressions
GarfReport in-memory tabular matrix and row slicer
Simulator for deterministic zero-network test report generation
GarfWorkflow and parallel DAG workflow execution

claims.claim: Declarative SQL query parsing transforms standard SQL SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ... clauses into typed API request parameters and nested field extraction paths without requiring procedural API client code.
Dynamic date macros (:YYYYMMDD-N, :TODAY) dynamically compute rolling date windows at evaluation time, eliminating stale hardcoded date strings in recurring reporting pipelines.
The Simulator generates synthetic GarfReport batches matching query column specifications without network requests, shielding external API rate limits and quotas during verification loops.
Two-stage analytical workflow DAGs orchestrate data extraction from reporting APIs into intermediate staging storage, followed by execution of post-processing analytical SQL queries.
